mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized growth > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ growth < -1% does not correlate with negative 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 10% does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not correlate with negative 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) show a simultaneous decline over the previous month, it signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint decline of GDPC1 and RSAFS does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (p > 0.05).
